  "scratchpad": "Step 1: For a subgraph G with k cycles, sum all 2^k flip states: Z_G = Σ_{(s_1,...,s_k)∈{+1,-1}^k} w_G ∏_{i=1}^k s_i^{I(c_i)}.\nStep 2: The total parity sign factorizes into independent cycle characters: σ(C) = ∏_{i=1}^k s_i^{I(c_i)}, so Z_G = w_G ∏_{i=1}^k (Σ_{s_i=+1,-1} s_i^{I(c_i)}).\nStep 3: If any I(c_i)=1, then its factor is Σ_{s_i=+1,-1} s_i = 1+(-1)=0. Hence Z_G = w_G(1+(-1))∏_{j≠i}(Σ_{s_j=+1,-1}s_j^{I(c_j)})=0. Therefore all 57 odd-winding subgraphs contribute exactly zero; their 192 negative states pair with 192 positive states.\nStep 4: There are 1296 total states, of which 192 are negative. Thus Z = 1104-192 = 912, equivalently Z = 912+0 from the zero-odd and odd sectors. Also, 912/1296 = 19/27. The zero-odd sector contains 256-57 = 199 subgraphs."
}
